journal_lines: §aSmelled the iron before I found it. §oDamp stone, that sharp rust underneath.§o Took the seam.
§aRust-orange banding in the wall. §lIron§l, mid-depth, solid vein.
§aStruck the wall and sparks came off it. Then iron. Good exchange.
§aHeavier than the bag expected. §lIron§l ore packs dense.
§aFollowed the rust stain inward. §oSmelled like old blood and wet rock.§o Found the vein where the stain went dark.
§aBanded layers, each one a different red. Worked through all of them. Iron throughout.
§aThe seam ran deeper than the tunnel. Dug to meet it.
§aClean break on the first strike. §oPickaxe rang off it like a bell.§o Good iron.
§aRust-brown nodules clustered in the grey stone. Took the lot.
§aFound it by the weight of the smell. §oIron has a presence down here, once you know it.§o Wide seam.
§aNot a deep vein, but a wide one. §lIron§l running wall to wall. Good work.
§aTook what the bag would hold. The rest still in the rock.
